{"edit_description":"Create a NEW single self-contained HTML file (it does not exist yet): "neuron_growth_zai-glm-5.3_01.html" — an animated glowing neuron-network growth visualization using HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript and dat.gui ONLY (dat.gui loaded from CDN: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js). No other libraries, images, or assets. One 800×800 <canvas id="c"> centered on a dark page. All code inline in one file, organized into commented sections: SETUP, GUI SETUP, NEURON GROWTH, SYNAPSE DETECTION, PULSE ANIMATION, RENDERING, MAIN LOOP. Do NOT mention any game, movie, brand, or copyrighted style name anywhere in code or comments.

=== PALETTE (exact values) ===
Background #05070f, background glow #101a3a, main branch color #00e5ff, secondary/accent branch color #d6ff00, synapse color #ff2bd6, pulse color #fff36a, UI/accent #ffd400, grid/scanline color rgba(0,229,255,0.08). Look: futuristic, high contrast, glowing, slightly gritty. Use ctx.shadowBlur for all neon glow. No images/textures.

=== PAGE / CSS ===
body: margin 0, background #05070f, display flex, center canvas both axes, min-height 100vh. Canvas: 800×800, box-shadow glow (e.g. 0 0 60px rgba(0,229,255,0.25)), thin border 1px solid rgba(0,229,255,0.25). Title/heading optional small monospace label above canvas in #ffd400.

=== SETUP SECTION ===
- Get canvas + ctx, W=H=800.
- Pre-render two offscreen canvases once (performance): (1) scanlines overlay: horizontal 1px lines every 3px in rgba(0,229,255,0.08) plus a faint grid every 40px same color; (2) vignette: radial gradient transparent center → rgba(0,0,0,0.55) edges covering canvas.
- params object holding ALL gui values with sensible defaults: neuronCount 4, growthSpeed 2.2, maxDepth 7, splitChance 0.12, curvature 0.35, maxBranchLength 130, synapseDist 26, synapseGlow 14, pulseSpeed 0.012, pulseFrequency 0.35, pulseBrightness 1.0, backgroundColor '#05070f', branchColor '#00e5ff', accentColor '#d6ff00', synapseColor '#ff2bd6', pulseColor '#fff36a', plus toggles showGrid true, showScanlines true.
- State arrays (lightweight objects only): neurons[], branches[], synapses[], pulses[], synapseKeys Set (prevents duplicate synapses), paused=false, growthDone=false, time=0.

=== GUI SETUP SECTION ===
new dat.GUI({ width: 300 }). Folders:
- 'Growth': neuronCount (3–6 step 1), growthSpeed (0.5–6), maxDepth (3–12 step 1), splitChance (0–0.6), curvature (0–1), maxBranchLength (40–300).
- 'Synapses': synapseDist (8–80), synapseGlow (0–40).
- 'Pulses': pulseSpeed (0.002–0.05), pulseFrequency (0.02–1), pulseBrightness (0.2–2).
- 'Visuals': backgroundColor, branchColor, accentColor, synapseColor, pulseColor (dat.gui addColor), showGrid, showScanlines (checkboxes).
Root buttons: 'Regenerate Network' → regenerate(); 'Clear Canvas' → clearNetwork(); 'Pause / Resume Animation' → togglePause(). Style dat.gui with CSS override so its background/accent matches palette (accent #ffd400).

=== NEURON GROWTH SECTION ===
regenerate(): clearNetwork() then create params.neuronCount seed neurons randomly near center (within ~180px of canvas center), each { x, y, pulse: random phase }. For each neuron spawn 4–6 initial branches at evenly spread random angles.
Branch object: { x, y, angle, depth, len, maxLen, width (0.6–2.2 randomized, thinner as depth increases), accent (random ~25% flagged accent color), points: [x,y start], neuron (root neuron ref), done:false, parent:null }.
growStep(): for each not-done branch (cap total branches at 600): advance by params.growthSpeed px; angle += (Math.random()-0.5) * params.curvature * 0.5 for organic wander; append point every step; len += growthSpeed. Occasionally (params.splitChance per step, only if depth < maxDepth and branches.length < 600) spawn a side branch: same position, angle ± 0.5–1.1 rad, depth+1, maxLen ~ 55–75% of parent, width thinner, inherits or new accent flag. Branch finishes (done=true) when len >= maxLen OR depth >= maxDepth OR it leaves canvas bounds (margin 10). Growth phase ends when no active branches remain → growthDone=true.
clearNetwork(): empty all arrays, synapseKeys.clear(), growthDone=false. togglePause(): paused=!paused.

=== SYNAPSE DETECTION SECTION ===
Each frame during AND after growth: collect finished branch tips; for each pair of tips from DIFFERENT root neurons with distance < params.synapseDist, key = sorted pair of unique tip ids (give each branch an id counter); skip if synapseKeys has key; else create synapse { ax, ay, bx, by, x:mid, y:mid, t: random phase, path: combined polyline }. Path built once at creation: walk tip A's chain of points back to its neuron root (each branch stores its full points array), reverse it, then append tip B's points from its root forward — a single polyline from neuron A to neuron B through the synapse midpoint. Keep point arrays decimated (every ~4th point) to stay light. Only check finished tips, and cap synapses at ~80.

=== PULSE ANIMATION SECTION ===
updatePulses(): spawn new pulses randomly — probability per frame = params.pulseFrequency (skip if growthDone false or synapses empty); pulse = { synapse, t: 0 (or 1 for reverse, random direction), dir ±1, trail: [] }. Advance t += params.pulseSpeed * dir; interpolate position along the synapse path polyline by arc-length fraction (precompute cumulative segment lengths once per synapse); remove when t<0 or t>1. Draw later as bright moving spark with short fading trail (store last ~6 positions).

=== RENDERING SECTION (every frame via requestAnimationFrame) ===
1. Background: fillRect with params.backgroundColor; radial gradient glow #101a3a (alpha ~0.85) centered, radius ~420, composited under everything. If showGrid/showScanlines draw the pre-rendered overlay canvas.
2. Neurons: glowing node circles (#ffd400 core with branchColor halo, radius 4–6 pulsing slightly with sin(time)).
3. Branches: iterate all branches; for each, draw its points as a smoothed polyline using quadraticCurveTo through midpoints (lightweight organic curves); strokeStyle = accent ? params.accentColor : params.branchColor; lineWidth = branch.width; shadowBlur 8, shadowColor same stroke color; globalAlpha ~0.85. Draw each frame from stored points (branches are static once grown).
4. Synapses: at each synapse midpoint draw a glowing dot: radius 2.5 + sin(time*3 + t)*1.2 pulsing, fillStyle params.synapseColor, shadowBlur = params.synapseGlow (brighter than branches), plus a faint diamond/star sparkle.
5. Pulses: for each pulse draw trail as fading segments in params.pulseColor with alpha gradient, head as small bright circle (white-ish core: mix pulseColor + #ffffff), shadowBlur 18 * pulseBrightness, globalAlpha pulseBrightness; slight jitter offset (±0.8px random) for electric spark feel.
6. Vignette overlay drawn last. 
Use ctx.save()/restore() around shadow settings to keep perf. Avoid heavy operations — no per-pixel loops except pre-rendered overlays.

=== MAIN LOOP ===
requestAnimationFrame loop: time += 0.016 always; if (!paused) { if (!growthDone) growStep(); detectSynapses(); updatePulses(); } render() every frame regardless (so GUI color changes reflect live); display growth status via document title or small overlay text (optional). Keep code simple, compact, with short comments per section. Also handle window: initialize on load, regenerate() once at start.","path":"neuron_growth_zai-glm-5.3_01.html"}
